test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If '+' means 'subtraction', '÷' means 'addition, '–' means multiplication' and '×' means 'division', then what is the value of 15 ÷ (5 + 8)?
solution:
Given expression: 15 ÷ (5 + 8)

And sign changes are as follow-

• '+' → '–'

• '÷' → '+'

• '–' → '×'

• '×' → '÷'
